messages.subject: Population labels VCF import
parts:
Hi,

I've been trying to figure out for a long time how to get population labels working with my VCF data. I haven't found any functions that do so. Moreover, I've tried to interconvert between VCF, fasta, genind, genclone, DNAbin and add my own population labels, but all of these approaches seem to fail.

Any input on this would be immensely helpful, since I cannot use GenAlEx (Mac 2016 bug).

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Population labels VCF import
parts:
Hi, If you have the population data in a separate table/spreadsheet, you can import that spreadsheet into a data frame using read.table() and then add it to your data set using the strata() function.

An example workflow might go something like this, assuming you have two files: a VCF file and a csv file containing columns for individual, population, and subpopulation:


# load the libraries -----------------------------------------

library("vcfR")
library("poppr")

# read in the data -------------------------------------------

dat      <- read.vcfR("myvcf.vcf")
mystrata <- read.csv("popsubpop.csv")

# Convert to genclone and add the strata ---------------------

dat.gc         <- as.genclone(vcfR2genind(dat))
sampleorder    <- match(indNames(dat.gc), mystrata$individual)
strata(dat.gc) <- mystrata[sampleorder, ] # make sure the samples are ordered correctly
setPop(dat.gc) <- ~population             # set the population factor


You can also look at the strata tutorial about what the strata represents: https://github.com/thibautjombart/adegenet/wiki/Tutorials

Hope that helps,
Zhian
